nextStoryContext: US-003 (sidecar generic gate lifecycle) wires src/supervisor/gate.ts + the new `cam decide` verb into the sidecar's outer loop (src/commands/sidecar.ts). `cam decide` (src/commands/decide.ts) is a pure CLI thin-proxy: it reads the gate file (fail-closed readGateFile), validates decision against options[], writes decision back into the SAME .claude/.cam-gate.json (join(cwd, '.claude', GATE_FILENAME)) via writeGateFile, and returns an exit code -- it does NOT poll, does NOT clear the gate file, and does NOT flip phase. US-003 is responsible for: writing the gate file when the sidecar reaches an operator-decision point (phase:awaiting-operator + gate file + orchestrator-pane notify), polling for a populated decision (re-validate against options[] again before acting -- cam decide's validation is not trusted transitively), dispatching resolution generically by gate discriminator, deleting the gate file on resolution (consumed-on-resolution, mirroring clearStalePlanArtifacts for stale gates from a crashed prior run), and flipping phase. index.ts changes: added 'decide' to COMMANDS array (now 27, alphabetically-independent order after 'resume'), DECIDE_HELP (renderHelp block), HELP_REGISTRY entry, top-level HELP command list entry, and a switch case mirroring the 'resume'/'drain' case shape (parseDecideArgs -> null/help/decision branches). test/commands-freeze.test.ts's FROZEN_COMMANDS + count assertion (26->27) had to be updated in the same commit -- it is an explicit intentional freeze list, not incidental breakage.
